data.name: Iqlas
data.gender_notes: Iqlas is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: To be truthful in one's actions and words. The name Iqlas carries the meaning “Sincerity” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Iqlas usually hope their child will grow to embody sincerity and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Representing a person who is sincere in their faith and actions
data.etymology: Iqlas belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Sincerity.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Iqlas total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_arabic.name: إخلاص
in_arabic.meaning: إخلاص القلب لله وحده، الإخلاص في الدين والعبادة
in_arabic.long_meaning: الإخلاص هو اسم من أسماء الله الحسنى، ويعني إخلاص القلب لله وحده، والإخلاص في الدين والعبادة، وهو من الأسماء التي وردت في القرآن الكريم، قال تعالى: 'قل هو الله أحد * الله الصمد * لم يلد ولم يولد * ولم يكن له كفوا أحد'، وهذه الآية تعبر عن إخلاص الله وحده في العبادة والتوحيد.

in_urdu.name: اخلاص
in_urdu.meaning: خلوص نیت، دین اور عبادت میں خلوص
in_urdu.long_meaning: اخلاص ایک خوبصورت نام ہے جو خلوص نیت اور دین اور عبادت میں خلوص کے معنی میں ہے۔ یہ نام عربی زبان سے ماخوذ ہے اور قرآن کریم میں بھی ذکر کیا گیا ہے۔ اخلاص کا مطلب ہے کہ کسی چیز کو صرف اللہ کے لیے کرنا، اور اسی کو اپنا واحد مقصد بنانا۔

in_hindi.name: इखलास
in_hindi.meaning: ईश्वर के लिए समर्पण, धर्म और पूजा में शुद्धता
in_hindi.long_meaning: इखलास एक सुंदर नाम है जिसका अर्थ है ईश्वर के लिए समर्पण और धर्म और पूजा में शुद्धता। यह नाम अरबी भाषा से लिया गया है और कुरआन में भी इसका उल्लेख है। इखलास का अर्थ है कि किसी भी काम को केवल ईश्वर के लिए करना और उसे अपना एकमात्र उद्देश्य बनाना।

in_pashto.name: اخلاص
in_pashto.meaning: د الله لپاره خلوص، په دين او عبادت کې خلوص
in_pashto.long_meaning: اخلاص يو ښکلی نوم دی چې د الله لپاره خلوص او په دين او عبادت کې خلوص معنی لري. دا نوم د عربي ژبې څخه اخیستل شوی دی او په قرآن کریم کې هم ذکر شوی دی. اخلاص معنی دا دی چې کوم کار يوازې د الله لپاره کول او هغه کار یوازې د الله رضا لپاره ترسره کول.

in_english.name: Iqlas
in_english.meaning: Sincerity, devotion to Allah, purity in faith and worship
in_english.long_meaning: Iqlas is a beautiful name that signifies sincerity and devotion to Allah. It is derived from the Arabic root 'q-l-s' which means 'to purify' or 'to make sincere'. In the Quran, Iqlas is mentioned as one of the essential qualities of a believer. The name Iqlas conveys the meaning of being pure in faith, devoted to Allah, and sincere in one's actions.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Iqlas" is of Arabic origin and holds a significant cultural impact in Islamic societies. In Islamic teachings, honesty and truthfulness are highly cherished virtues. The name "Iqlas" serves as a reminder of the importance of being truthful in all aspects of one's life. It encourages individuals to be sincere in their relationships, their work, and their dealings with others. The name is also a reflection of the Islamic principle of "Al-Istikharah," which encourages individuals to seek guidance from Allah in all their affairs, including in being truthful. In everyday life, individuals may use the name as a reminder to be truthful in their actions and words.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name "Iqlas" lies in its connection to truth and sincerity in the eyes of Allah. In Islamic teachings, truthfulness is seen as a means to draw closer to Allah and to please Him. The name "Iqlas" serves as a reminder of the importance of being truthful not only in one's actions and words but also in one's intentions and thoughts. It is believed that true devotion and worship of Allah can only be accomplished through honesty and sincerity. The name also serves as a reminder of the Day of Judgment, when individuals will be held accountable for their actions and words before Allah. The name "Iqlas" is a call to strive for truthfulness in all aspects of one's life, not just for the sake of pleasing others or conforming to societal norms, but for the pleasure of Allah and the attainment of closeness to Him.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Sincerity" symbolizes To be truthful in one's actions and words. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Iqlas serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of sincerity.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Ibn Kathir, Al-Bidayah wa al-Nihayah, Vol. 12, p. 241. The name Iqlas carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Iqlas was the name of a Christian Arab poet who converted to Islam and became a close companion of the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh). He is known for his poetry in praise of Islam and the Prophet.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Iqlas remains relevant in modern Muslim society, representing a bridge between traditional Islamic values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Islamic names.

name_in_real_life.story: Khadija Iqlas, a teacher in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, shares that their name Iqlas meaning "Sincerity" has been a source of inspiration throughout their life, motivating them to be a positive influence in their community.
